skills.name: Spell Curse
skills.description:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) (+ 6% target's ) Magic Damage. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and recovers 8% of his  on hit.

Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4s.

skills.name: Tyrant's Revenge
skills.description: Khufra pulls the bandages on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing 50 (+ 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his ) Physical Damage to all enemies on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering the first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50 (+ 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his ) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for up to 1s.

skills.name: Bouncing Ball
skills.description:
Khufra uses bandages to wrap himself into a Bouncing Ball, increasing his  by 30%. Enemies trying to use mobility skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.

Each time the Bouncing Ball hits the ground, it deals 50 (+ 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his ) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 0.2s.

skills.name: Tyrant's Rage
skills.description: Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra Physical Damage equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

assist.desc: Khufra works best with heroes with strong CC abilities that make it easier for his 1st Skill to hit, such as Eudora and Pharsa.

strong.desc: Khufra's 2nd Skill can be used to interrupt movement abilities, making him strong against heroes who fight with movement abilities, such as Joy and Lancelot.

weak.desc: Khufra is countered by resilient tank heroes, as his CC abilities pose no threat to these heroes. Heroes like Fredrinn and Gloo are good examples here.
